context.why: Second story of FS-030. US1 is accepted on this branch: Sample and Measurement both inherit LocatedRecord (location PointField 4326, location_elevation, location_uncertainty); fairdm/contrib/location/forms.py has parse_coordinate, Location, LocationField, LocationWidget and LocationFormMixin, wired into SampleFormMixin so a sample type gets the input only when its registration lists 'location'. Point is gone. This story gives a measurement the same input (MeasurementFormMixin on LocationFormMixin, shown only when the measurement type's registration lists location, FR-009), adds the effective location (plan D5: MeasurementQuerySet.with_effective_location(user=None) annotating effective_location via Case: own location, else the sample's when the sample is in Sample.objects.visible_to(user), else null; Measurement.effective_location_for(user) returning point, elevation, uncertainty and 'own'|'sample', or None, reading that annotation for its own row so the visibility rule is written once), and makes the measurement overview use it. The approved template block overview.location in fairdm/core/measurement/templates/measurement/measurement_overview.html already expects an `own_location` context value and titles the card 'Measurement location' for the measurement's own and 'Sample location' for the sample's; adapt the plugin context so the approved screen is produced from effective_location_for(request.user) — keep the markup and copy as approved. The demo's XRF measurement registration (demo/config.py XRFMeasurementConfig.fields) lists location, and the demo seed (demo/seed/measurements.py) gives the fully described XRF measurement its own location (lat 49.09495, lon 8.43180, elevation 112, uncertainty 25) as the approved prototype did.
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D2: Organization holds a plain point, a Person holds none. Contributor.location is removed.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.
Do not build the lookups (inside, within_distance, nearest), the spatial coverage, tables, API or import/export: later stories.

verified_base.note: US1 accepted. Full verify green on 71cdaf6f, then only spec-directory commits: about 6,850 tests on PostGIS, about 4 to 6 minutes.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given a measurement type listing location, its edit form has the location input and saves a typed location like a sample's; a type not listing it has none. Given a measurement with its own location, its page shows that location as the measurement's. Given none of its own and a sample the viewer may open, the page shows the sample's location as the sample's. Given a sample the viewer may not open, the page shows no location. Changing the sample's location leaves the measurement's own unchanged.

MeasurementFormMixin uses LocationFormMixin; with_effective_location and effective_location_for exist as plan D5 and share one visibility rule; the measurement overview is driven by effective_location_for(request.user) with the approved markup; the demo XRF registration lists location and its seed has its own location.
docs/portal-development/locations.md describes a measurement's own location and its effective location with examples that run; FS-018's spec text matches.
